answer: Sybil resistance relies on bonded collateral in per-identity escrows and joint evidence of correlated equivocation: when k identities coordinate, each punishable pair contributes a penalty, giving k(k−1)/2 = O(k²), rather than k isolated fixed fines. If a swarm named nectar, sable, and beacon is detected, asymmetric depreciation compounds forfeiture through an exponential multiplier on capital loss; splitting stake across aliases therefore increases, rather than diversifies, the cost.
